phases.name: Ready
phases.intent: Right lead foot, left rear leg; hands in guard

phases.name: The Pouch
phases.intent: Step right foot forward and extend the right arm to check the line

phases.name: The Coil
phases.intent: Retract the right hand as the hips wind up and weight shifts over the support leg

phases.name: The Launch
phases.intent: Reverse the hip turn; chamber and extend the left rear-leg kick

phases.name: Follow
phases.intent: Carry the kick through its arc without freezing at extension

phases.name: Recoil
phases.intent: Fold the left knee and return it under control

phases.name: Recover
phases.intent: Replace the left foot and unwind the torso into guard

phases.name: Guard
phases.intent: Finish in the advanced right-lead stance
